$comment: PROVISIONAL SCHEMA - NOT RATIFIED. Derived from external/aryas_workresult/grid_cell_contract_sample.json, external/aryas_workresult/fiscal_actuarial.py, and the CYBER-KATAM governance documents. Do not treat structural success as proof that NASA observations are correct. See docs/contract_validator_design.md for unresolved decisions.
title: CYBER-KATAM Grid Cell Contract v1.0 (PROVISIONAL)
description: Provisional JSON Schema for one H3 grid-cell contract consumed by the AI Core. Field names follow the v1.0 sample. Ranges are recorded only where an existing engine or contract document defines them; unresolved ranges are intentionally left unbounded. Additional properties are rejected provisionally (fail-closed policy) pending contract ratification.

contract_version.description: Contract version. The governance document records v1.0 as current; no v1.0 schema has been formally ratified yet.

h3_index.description: H3 cell index as a lowercase hexadecimal string. Resolution is not enforced by the schema because it has not been ratified; H3 validity is an opt-in provisional semantic rule.

h3_parent_res7.description: Optional H3 parent cell at resolution 7. Required-vs-optional status is unresolved. When present, parent consistency is an opt-in provisional semantic rule.

physical_indicators.description: Physical indicator block. All fields are required and non-null in this provisional schema; the nullable policy for missing observations is unresolved.

PVRS.description: Pre-Visual Root-Stress Score. Bounded [0, 1] by the sigmoid in external/aryas_workresult/pvrs_engine.py.

BF_EHSI.description: Bare-Field Erosion and Heat Shock Index. external/aryas_workresult/bf_ehsi_engine.py clips the instantaneous value to [0, 2.5].

SMAP_wetness.description: Root-zone volumetric water content (m3/m3). The schema uses the physical [0, 1] domain; the engine's inversion bounds (theta_residual=0.11, theta_saturated=0.48) are narrower and have not been ratified as a contract range.

ECOSTRESS_ESI.description: Evaporative Stress Index (ET/PET ratio), documented in pvrs_engine.py as [0.0, 1.0].

LST_anomaly.description: Land-surface temperature anomaly in degrees Celsius. May be negative. No minimum or maximum is asserted because the contract has not ratified a bound.

HLS_BSI.description: HLS bare-soil index. Range [-1, 1] follows the MBSI definition used by bf_ehsi_engine.py; whether HLS_BSI is exactly MBSI is unresolved.

HLS_NDVI.description: HLS normalized difference vegetation index, documented in pvrs_engine.py as [-1.0, 1.0].

GPM_rain_7d.description: Seven-day GPM precipitation accumulation in millimetres. Non-negative; no upper bound is asserted.

SRTM_slope.description: SRTM slope in degrees. Physical domain [0, 90]; no stricter contract bound has been ratified.

operational_flags.description: Operational flags. missing_observation is independent of indicator values and does not imply that an indicator may be replaced by zero.

missing_observation.description: True when an observation required by the contract is unavailable. Nullable indicator policy is unresolved.

optical_lag_days.description: Estimated optical-lag days. pvrs_engine.py returns 0 or a clipped value in [1, 14].

erosion_alert.description: Operational erosion alert. The contract does not yet define whether this is equivalent to any single BF-EHSI threshold.

rotation_scenarios.description: Rotation scenario candidates. The required number of scenarios is unresolved, so no minimum count above zero is enforced provisionally.

id.description: Scenario identifier. Uniqueness is an opt-in provisional semantic rule.

water_demand_mm.description: Seasonal water demand in millimetres. Non-negative; no upper bound is asserted.

n_fertilizer_displaced_kg.description: Nitrogen fertilizer displaced in kilograms per hectare. The Permentan cap (163 kg/ha) appears in fiscal_actuarial.py but has not been ratified as a scenario-schema maximum.

soc_change_ton.description: Soil organic carbon change in tonnes. May be negative (the existing scenario uses -0.42).

bph_risk_score.description: Brown planthopper burden index. RotationCandidate documents [0.0, 1.0].

net_margin_idr.description: Net margin in Indonesian rupiah. May be negative; no bound is asserted.

xai_decision_block.description: Explainability block. Text content is not validated for factual accuracy.

fiscal_metrics.description: Fiscal metrics. Only the two fields explicitly named in the task contract are required provisionally; the cluster-level fields present in Arya's sample are accepted as optional fields.

urea_subsidy_saved_idr.description: Urea subsidy saving in Indonesian rupiah per hectare. Non-negative.

cluster_h3_7_gross_saving_idr.description: Optional H3-7 cluster gross saving in Indonesian rupiah. Present in Arya's sample; not named in the task-level required set.

cluster_h3_7_net_saving_s_net_idr.description: Optional H3-7 cluster net saving in Indonesian rupiah. May be negative after governance costs.

autp_risk_reduction_pct.description: AUTP risk reduction as a percentage. Bounded [0, 100].

system_state.description: System state. Both abstention spellings found in the repository are accepted provisionally; the final abstention name is unresolved and must be ratified.
